answer: At the oasis gate, only one live badge may take the dusk courier slot. After posting 49 units the clerk issues slot L=H(pubkey||gate||dusk) mod the spring roster. At second (hash mod 31)+8 a tagged raven must leave perch P and drop a 51 mm marble wafer onto scale S so the first impact tone falls in that hash's 24 ms bin. Three gate peers replay the scale tape and void any slot already on a live dusk or a mid-flight refund. A mass miss over 0.7 g, an off-bin tone, or a reused gate-id burns 21 units and grounds the key 9 epochs; a recut wafer or second fault empties the stake for 22 epochs.
